retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist country-folk composition featuring human subjects interacting with a miniature house in a vast natural landscape with bold, warm-toned serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key outdoor photograph where two men appear as giants sitting on the roof of a small, detailed farmhouse. The scene is set in a rolling green field under a bright, blown-out white sky, anchored by large, vibrant yellow serif text in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between oversized human subjects and a miniature architectural structure
Color harmony between the yellow title text and the yellow front door of the house
Vertical hierarchy placing the bold title at the top and the artist name at the bottom
Horizontal grounding of the house within a textured, grassy meadow
coreInvariants: Miniature house with a yellow door
Warm, golden-hour lighting on the grass

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The miniature house is centered in the lower half; human subjects are scaled up to sit on its roof. The title dominates the upper-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The miniature house serves as the central focal point, while the yellow title provides a heavy visual weight in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large yellow title, move down to the human subjects on the roof, follow the house down to the grass, and finally rest on the artist name at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space in the upper half of the frame creates a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (sky) and Green (grass) provide the environmental backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Yellow (typography and door) provides a vibrant, warm focal point.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Blue (denim) and Brown (roof/guitar) provide natural, earthy tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow elements against a high-value, low-contrast sky.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain natural earth tones in the landscape

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' with a closed loop and soft ear
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, soft serif for the title paired with a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif for the artist name.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and rounded serif aesthetic.
Provides a similar soft, vintage-inspired serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a miniature white farmhouse with a yellow door sitting in a tall grassy field. Place two men in casual clothing sitting on the roof of the house, looking towards the camera. The sky should be a bright, overexposed white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title in the top left corner using a heavy rounded serif font in warm yellow. Add the artist name in the bottom center using a bold, all-caps sans-serif font in the same yellow color with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Does the yellow of the text match the yellow of the house door?
Is the scale of the men clearly larger than the house?
Is the title font heavy and rounded?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or faces
postGenerationChecks: Check for seamless integration between the subjects and the roof
Ensure the yellow text is legible against the white sky
Verify the horizon line is straight and low in the frame
Confirm the miniature house details are sharp
recipe.reuseFormula: Surreal Scale + Country Landscape + Bold Rounded Serif + Yellow Accents
